title: Reflection by a half space with magnetoelectric gyrotropy
source: A. Lakhtakia, arXiv 1811.05034v1 (2018), Section 3, Eqs. 2 and 17-29; parameters of Fig. 3
notes: The medium: D = eps0 eps_r E - Gamma x H, B = mu0 mu_r H + Gamma x E (Eqs. 2). In this program's units (derivation note, Section 1) that is rho = -[g]x and rho' = [g]x with g = c0 Gamma and [g]x the cross-product matrix. Fig. 3's parameters: eps_r = 5 + 0.4i, mu_r = 1.1 + 0.05i, c0 Gamma = (0.9 + 0.01i, 0.3 + 0.01i, 0), plane of incidence at psi0 = 60 degrees, here as a sample azimuth of -60 degrees (the material turned by -60 is the plane turned by +60). Lakhtakia uses exp(-iwt) with dissipation as positive imaginary parts, as this program does. The test compares the reflectances of Eqs. 22-29.
